OOP Scenario 02

The University System

Understanding Association & Composition

Concept: Object Relationships

Classes rarely work alone. Association is when one object knows about another (e.g., A Course knows its Teacher). Composition (or Aggregation) is when one object contains a collection of others (e.g., A Course contains a list of Students).

Class Structure

The "We Do" Task

Step-by-Step Instructions

  1. Download the starter file below.
  2. Observe how the Course class takes a Teacher object in its __init__. This is Dependency Injection.
  3. Complete the enroll_student(self, student) method. It should append the student object to self.students.
  4. Complete `roll_call()`. Loop through `self.students` and call `introduce()` on each one.
  5. Main Block: Create one Teacher ("Mr. Smith"), one Course ("CS101"), and three Students. Link them together and verify the roll call works.
